decisions.reason: The 15-day express option overlaps with the broader express line and lacks prominent website placement, so its option value remains low and the firm abandons this redundant option.
The 72-hour express program retains a distinct speed advantage and low keeping cost while demand uncertainty persists, so the firm keeps the option open.
The fire-resistant exterior door has European approval and home-page prominence, signaling realized value, so the firm keeps it.
The express delivery product line has its own page and covers multiple segments, so the option still has value while demand uncertainty resolves.
The online platform is a strategic digital option with high uncertainty and option value, so the firm keeps it.
